title: Homeostatic feelings are the inaugural events of consciousness

statements.text: Homeostatic feelings are the first events of consciousness and its natural grounding. Each one, from hunger and pain to the feeling of breathing, informs the organism that it exists, how it is faring, and that it may need to act.

sources.quote: the strangely unrecognized status of homeostatic feelings as the inaugural events of consciousness itself
is telling us, in no uncertain terms, that we exist, that we are faring well or not so well
Such feelings are the natural grounding of consciousness
